subject: [PATCH v2 2/8] nfsd: make max_blksize a per-namespace setting

2026-09-22.patch_summary: This patch makes the maximum block size a per-namespace setting in the NFS daemon, rather than a global module-scope variable. This change prevents containerized environments from affecting other namespaces' payload sizes. The patch moves the max_blksize field into the struct nfsd_net and updates various functions to use this new field instead of the global variable. As a result, each namespace can now have its own maximum block size, which is set lazily on first server start in that namespace.
